verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pika publishes its own MCP server for agents such as ChatGPT and Claude to connect to. That is the server role. Nothing documents Pika acting as an MCP client that accepts user-added MCP servers and uses their tools. For a conversational AI creative platform this axis plausibly applies, so the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
